content.technique_notes: Direct source-path decomposition from the Recent Activity section. content.title: Review recent activity status pill rendering
content.intent: Prove visible recent-activity statuses are rendered as compact pill-style labels.
content.technique_notes: Direct source-path decomposition from the Status presentation rule. Negative, boundary, and combinatorial techniques were not applicable because the source stated a single presentation promise and no editable inputs or alternate outcomes. Budget estimate: 1 scenario/test pair for this path, within the max_pairs ceiling of 8.

judgements.rationale: [applicability] Applied direct path decomposition only. Equivalence partitioning and boundary value analysis were not applicable because the use-case exposes no constrained user input. Negative, auth, CRUD, concurrency, idempotency, and state-flow techniques were not applicable because the source evidenced a read-only table with no gated access, mutation, or multi-step transition. Search/list pagination and filter techniques were not applicable because the Recent Activity section specified columns and sample rows only, with no pagination, sorting control, or filtering semantics. A11y, responsiveness, perf, and i18n were not minted because the current PRD lines did not state measurable promises for those families in this section.
